description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Vladimir''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charges]] for up to 1.5 seconds, during which he increases ''Tides of Blood's'' damage over the first second of the channel, and becomes [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 20% afterwards for the remaining duration. ''Tides of Blood'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or if it is [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]].
description.text: Active: Vladimir charges for up to 1.5 seconds, during which he increases Tides of Blood's damage over the first second of the channel, and becomes slowed by 20% afterwards for the remaining duration. Tides of Blood can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or if it is interrupted.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Vladimir''' unleashes a nova of 15 blood bolts around himself that each deal magic damage to the first enemy hit, increased based on charge time up to the first second.
description2.text: Recast: Vladimir unleashes a nova of 15 blood bolts around himself that each deal magic damage to the first enemy hit, increased based on charge time up to the first second.

description3.raw: If ''Tides of Blood'' was charged for at least 1 second, enemies hit are also [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] for 0.5 seconds.
description3.text: If Tides of Blood was charged for at least 1 second, enemies hit are also slowed for 0.5 seconds.

description4.raw: ''Enemies can intercept multiple bolts, but can be damaged only once.''
description4.text: Enemies can intercept multiple bolts, but can be damaged only once.

description5.raw: ''If '''Vladimir''' is below 12% of his '''maximum''' health, Tides of Blood will not cost any health.''
description5.text: If Vladimir is below 12% of his maximum health, Tides of Blood will not cost any health.
